up: List all approved drugs that have an indication for neoplasm (mesh_heading or efo_term containing 'neoplasm'). For each, return the drug's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication ID (drugind_id), the indication label (mesh_heading and efo_term), and the max phase for that specific indication.
sql:
WITH neoplasm_indications AS (
  SELECT
    di.drugind_id,
    di.mesh_id,
    di.mesh_heading,
    di.efo_id,
    di.efo_term,
    di.max_phase_for_ind,
    cr.molregno
  FROM drug_indication di
  JOIN compound_records cr ON di.record_id = cr.record_id
  WHERE (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%neoplasm%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%neoplasm%')
), approved_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ni.molregno,
    ni.drugind_id,
    ni.mesh_id,
    ni.mesh_heading,
    ni.efo_id,
    ni.efo_term,
    ni.max_phase_for_ind
  FROM neoplasm_indications ni
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ni.molregno = md.molregno
  WHERE md.max_phase = 4
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  ad.drugind_id,
  ad.mesh_heading,
  ad.efo_term,
  ad.max_phase_for_ind
FROM approved_drugs ad
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ad.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON ad.molregno = cs.molregno
